So the 2026-06-21 export carried the narrative COLUMNS but only 255-char stubs; the full text was never in the shapefile. scripts/nome_placer/enrich_ardf_fulltext.py keeps the validated WGS84 geometry from 6e99b9a EXACTLY (0/286 coords changed; NM101 still -165.286858,64.645544) and replaces the stubs with full text pulled per-record from mrdata's JSON service (https://mrdata.usgs.gov/ardf/json/<num>, full DB not shapefile; needs a real User-Agent or it 403s). 286 records, no fetch failures; geol_desc max 255->6701, location ->1158, work_expl ->3480; adds references (full bibliography) + reporter. Schema is a strict superset of the prior export. Staged at handoff/outbox/2026-06-24-ardf-nome-fulltext/ for the coordinator to route to fossick. DOWNSTREAM NOTE: the 2026-06-21 export DID contain the 255-char stubs, but kg_nome.jsonld has zero long-text, so fossick's re-ingest/KG build (b5dafba) dropped even the stubs -- fossick must carry the narrative columns through to occurrence nodes; re-export alone will not surface text in kg.html.
